items.title: noyb win: German DPA finds microtargeting by major political parties illegal
items.description: Political Microtargeting, Manipulation & Tracking Over three years ago, noyb filed complaints against several German political parties for unlawfully using political microtargeting during the 2021 federal election. Now, the Berlin Data Protection Authority has finally issued decisions concerning the Social Democrats (SPD), the Greens, the Left (Die LINKE), and the CDU. The conclusion: all of them unlawfully used microtargeting. The complaint against the AfD is still pending, because the party tried to fight the DPA’s investigative powers in court. Original research by ZDF Magazin Royale Original TV report (on YouTube) Original complaints by noyb Excerpts of the decisions by the Berlin DPA (DE) Political microtargeting illegal.
